title: Página da Vaga | Líder Central I - Afirmativa para Mulheres
description:
Job description

Somos uma empresa de materiais de construção e soluções sustentáveis. Temos um time que faz, que acredita e que constrói. Sempre juntos e com excelência, para chegarmos cada vez mais longe. Acreditamos que cada pessoa é única e aqui todos são tratados com equidade. Todos os dias, temos a chance de realizar algo novo e você pode fazer parte disso.#VemSerVC

Não me autodeclaro como uma mulher, posso me candidatar?

Não, pois essa é uma ação afirmativa de busca pela igualdade e equidade. Valorizamos seu interesse e vontade de fazer parte do grupo, por isso recomendamos um olhar para as outras oportunidades em aberto:

Main responsibilities

  • Apoiar a gestão da Central, liderando as atividades administrativo-operacionais e gerenciando sua equipe através da distribuição de tarefas.
  • Liderar atividades da área no que se refere à movimentação de produtos e insumos, gestão de frota, análises de qualidade e serviços administrativos, orientando equipe e solucionando os problemas operacionais pertinentes a fim de priorizar e distribuir tarefas.
  • Monitorar os processos de produção controlando as variáveis envolvidas, intervindo e controlando situações críticas e atípicas, de forma a garantir o cumprimento dos padrões estabelecidos.
  • Zelar pela continuidade do funcionamento da operação solicitando serviços de assistência técnica de equipamentos.
  • Atender e intervir em situações críticas e atípicas envolvendo os clientes criando soluções viáveis e contribuindo para a manutenção dos níveis de serviços acordados.
  • Treinar a equipe em relação aos procedimentos e padrões operacionais conforme política e planos definidos.
  • Participar na criação e manutenção de soluções de contingência com o superior.
  • Participar dos processos de recrutamento e seleção de pessoas realizando entrevistas e testes.
  • Zelar pelos equipamentos, recursos e materiais sob sua responsabilidade e pelo ambiente de trabalho.
  • Executar suas atividades dentro dos padrões predefinidos pelas normas de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente a fim de apoiar a empresa no cumprimento de suas metas.

Requirements and skills

  • Superior completo em Engenharia Civil
  • Engenharia de Produção
  • Administração de Empresa ou afins
  • Conhecimentos ou Treinamentos Necessários: Concreto
  • Tecnologia do Concreto
  • Gestão de Processos
  • Gestão de Pessoas
  • Habilitação B

Additional information

Nossos Jeito de Ser: Saúde e Segurança em Primeiro Lugar

Na VC, valorizamos a qualidade de vida dos nossos funcionários com um pacote de benefícios completo:

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Planos de saúde e odontológico para você e seus dependentes.
  • Vacina da gripe e auxílio medicamentos.
  • Terapias online para saúde mental.

Qualidade de Vida:

  • Acesso ao Pilar 24h com diversos profissionais como psicólogos, nutricionistas, veterinários, advogados e outros profissionais para atender você e sua família;
  • Total Pass com mais de 200 modalidades de atividades físicas;
  • Programa VC em Movimento que incentiva à prática de exercícios e atividades físicas.

Apoio à Família:

  • Brinquedos de fim de ano para filhos;
  • Programa VC e seu Bebê que irá proporcionar à gestante o esclarecimento de dúvidas durante todo período da gestão e por mais três meses após o nascimento do bebê, além de um valor mensal para compra de medicamentos.
  • Licença parental estendida para mães e pais.

Mobilidade e Tranquilidade Financeira:

  • Vale transporte;
  • Previdência privada;
  • PPR ou RV;
  • Seguro de vida.

Nutrição e Reconhecimento:

  • Vale refeição;
  • Natal Alimentação;
  • Programa de Reconhecimento por Tempo de Casa.

Nossos pacotes de benefícios são configurados conforme acordo coletivo da unidade e regras de elegibilidade.

Diversidade e Inclusão: Valorizamos todas as formas de diversidade. Candidate-se e mostre seu potencial. Esse pode ser o primeiro passo da nossa história juntos!

title: Primeiro Oficial de Náutica – Log-In Logística – Offshore
description:
Cargo: Primeiro Oficial de Náutica

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

É responsável pelas áreas da navegação, da manobra, da estiva, dos equipamentos de salvamento, da limpeza e manutenção do casco e conveses e da operação geral da embarcação.

  • Integrar o Quarto de Navegação de bordo;
  • Substituir o Oficial de Náutica do Quarto de Navegação e o Imediato (se for o mais antigo que a ele se segue) em todos os seus impedimentos legais;
  • Auxiliar em todas as manobras da embarcação, no local determinado pelo Comandante;
  • Ter sob sua responsabilidade o regimento de sinais e bandeiras, devidamente inventariado, artefatos pirotécnicos, lâmpadas, lanternas e outros sinais de emergência;
  • Ter sob sua responsabilidade as embarcações auxiliares e de salvamento e suas respectivas palamentas, bem como os seus aparelhos de lançamento;
  • Receber e fazer entrega de malas postais, fiscalizar a sua estivagem em lugar seguro e providenciar os documentos necessários ao recebimento e entrega;
  • Ter sob sua responsabilidade todo o material de controle de avarias e de controle a incêndio, em qualquer parte da embarcação;
  • Assessorar o comandante do navio nas manobras de aproximação, amarração, ancoragem (fundeio) e desancoragem (suspender), assim como nas operações de carga e descarga nos portos e terminais portuários.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa;
  • Categoria: 1ON
  • Regra: STCW A-II/2
  • Toda certificação em dia;
  • Desejável experiência com navios de container;
  • Experiência em navios.
  • Passaporte
  • Esquema vacinal COVID-19 completo.
  • Vacina febre amarela

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Certificações Obrigatórias:

  • Certificados NRs – Atualizados: NR 33, NR 35, NR 20 e NR 06
  • Radar & ARPA
  • ECDIS Genérico
  • Gerenciamento de Passadiço
  • Básico de Segurança
  • Embarcação de Resgate e Sobrevivência
  • Combate Avançado de Incêndios
  • Primeiros Socorros Médicos
  • Oficial de Proteção (SSO)
  • Cargas Perigosas

Benefícios:

O que a Log-In proporciona?

  • Pra cuidar da sua saúde física e mental: Plano de saúde e Plano odontológico, extensivos a seus dependentes; Programa Viva Bem: Com Atendimento focado na Saúde Física, Saúde Emocional e Saúde Social. Programa Amor de Mãe Programa de Gestantes | Amor de Mãe Wellhub (Desconto em academias).
  • Pra apoiar seu dia a dia: Auxílio Transporte (A cada embarque e desembarque); Vale Alimentação. No Natal, recebemos o alimentação em dobro; Loginers: Oportunidade de trabalhar e trocar conhecimentos diários com um time incrível e acolhedor; Ah! Por aqui comemoramos todas as grandes datas comemorativas
  • Pra desenvolver sua carreira: Construção de PDI (Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) com sua liderança; Cultura de feedback e desenvolvimento; Treinamentos e acesso a Universidade Corporativa (Unilog-In); Ciclo de Gente: Com Avaliação de Desempenho anual Acompanhamentos de Metas
  • Você no centro: Momento Terapêutico: O Momento Terapêutico une duas atividades, através de um intervalo focado em ginástica laboral e alongamentos. Squad de Diversidade: Por aqui, somos todos plurais. Temos um grupo de pessoas que fomentam temas sobre diversidade, equidade e inclusão. Reembolsos: Creche/Maternal; Programa Performance em Alto Mar; Participação nos Resultados;

title: Senior Solutions & Product Architect (Deputy CTO)
description:
Senior Solutions & Product Architect (Deputy CTO)

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

We’re looking for a Senior Solutions & Product Architect (Deputy CTO) to join our leadership team and scale alongside our cofounder & CTO. This is a client-facing, high-impact role that blends product strategy, solution architecture, and delivery leadership .

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with clients from day one to understand their business needs and shape solutions.
  • Define high-level product requirements, MVP scopes, and roadmaps.
  • Translate business goals into technical architectures and delivery plans.
  • Lead proposal creation (business framing + product requirements + technical approach).
  • Oversee delivery across multiple teams, ensuring quality and accountability.
  • Be a trusted advisor to clients, while mentoring engineering teams internally.
  • Help codify Oowlish’s playbooks so we can scale beyond any single leader.

Must Have

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or product/technical consulting.
  • Strong technical breadth (cloud, APIs, modern architectures).
  • Proven ability to lead multiple teams/projects and communicate with C-level stakeholders.
  • Experience defining product requirements and MVPs, not just technical designs.
  • Excellent communication skills (English required; Spanish/Portuguese a plus).
  • Backgrounds that could be a great fit: experience in consulting / outsourcing firms, CTOs or co-founders of startups, with hands-on experience balancing product, tech, and business.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and excited to grow into a future CTO/Partner role.

Benefits & Perks

  • Home office
  • Flexible Hours
  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company
  • International Projects
  • Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational)
  • Oowlish Fitness with Total Pass
  • Games and Competitions

Oowlish is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from diverse candidates.

title: Gerente de Ecommerce - Campinas SP
description:
Job description

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Main responsibilities

  • Diagnosticar, revisar e otimizar processos e procedimentos comerciais, promovendo a transformação digital entre canais físicos e digitais.
  • Gerenciar normas e regulamentos das ferramentas digitais comerciais.
  • Liderar os projetos de e-commerce (B2B, B2C e outros), priorizando investimentos e garantindo o crescimento sustentável dos canais online.
  • Desenvolver e executar o plano de negócios para o canal digital, com foco em performance, estratégia e fidelização de clientes.
  • Definir recursos e estratégias para a plataforma de e-commerce, visando aumento de tráfego e conversão.
  • Atuar em parceria com Marketing para garantir alinhamento da comunicação da marca com os objetivos comerciais digitais.
  • Gerenciar planos de ação por categoria/canal com base em dados e relatórios internos.
  • Realizar benchmarks constantes com líderes do mercado digital, buscando melhorias e inovação.
  • Analisar dados e estratégias de GTM (Go to Market), otimizando resultados e produtividade.
  • Participar e coordenar projetos multifuncionais com foco na integração dos canais digitais ao ecossistema Minerva.
  • Liderar e desenvolver equipe, promovendo a cultura da empresa e preparando sucessores.

Requirements and skills

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em Campinas (Parque Corporativo Bresco Viracopos).
  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida com e-commerce (B2B e B2C), transformação digital e gestão de canais de vendas online.
  • Vivência com projetos de integração entre canais on e offline.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e plataformas de e-commerce, CRM e análise de dados.
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas e projetos multifuncionais.
  • Perfil analítico, estratégico e voltado para resultados.
  • Desejável: Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de negócios, marketing digital ou tecnologia.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding-edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan, have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Overview

We’re a multi-brand organization providing advanced fleet management software, hardware, and consulting solutions that drive efficiency and profitability for fleet and field service companies worldwide. Our comprehensive approach combines GPS tracking, sensors, and cameras with scalable IoT SaaS software platforms, custom software development, and marketplace integrations.

Our mission is to truly understand our customers\' business needs and implement solutions that address pain points effectively, making fleets safer, more efficient, and more profitable. We serve a broad spectrum of fleet operations globally, from large enterprises to government entities and various businesses across waste management, transportation, emergency services, and more.

About the Role

We’re looking for a remote Senior Product Manager to own our IoT asset tracking product line, lead pod teams, and develop junior talent. You’ll drive the complete product lifecycle for connected devices in warehouses, trucks, worksites, and operational facilities. You’ll lead a pod of Developers, QA, and Support teams, develop platform features (e.g., map views, sensor data, temperature monitoring, geofenced alerts), evaluate and test BLE sensors and IoT hardware for integration, build analytics infrastructure, and launch AI-powered customer insights.

This is a high-impact growth opportunity. We launched this product 6 months ago, onboarding and deploying over 2,000 connected devices across North America, LATAM, and UAE. As the dedicated owner, you’ll accelerate delivery and capture market opportunities, creating an end-to-end journey connecting warehouse and cargo management with vehicle tracking.

Responsibilities

description:
Overview

phData is a remote-first global company with employees based in the United States, Latin America and India.   • Source active and passive candidates through a variety of channels, building strong pipelines of talent.

  • Lead the offer stage, including extending offers and negotiating compensation.
  • Coordinate interview logistics and scheduling with efficiency, ensuring readiness of both candidates and panelists.
  • Collaborate across multiple teams—data analytics, engineering, managed services, program management, and more—ensuring we bring the best talent into every corner of the business.

Requirements

  • 5–8 years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced environment.

  • Full-cycle recruiting expertise, from sourcing through closing and negotiation.
  • Proven ability to engage and convert passive candidates.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to thrive in a lean team environment.
  • Professional-level English communication skills (reading, writing, speaking).

Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end recruiting lifecycle: sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, and supporting offers.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates, delivering an excellent and timely candidate experience.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple open positions across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Maintain excellence across core recruitment KPIs, including time-to-fill, source-of-hire, pipeline conversion, and candidate/hiring manager satisfaction.
  • Partner with hiring managers in a consultative capacity, advising on recruitment strategy, interview process, and market insights.
  • Use phData’s recruiting tools and systems to manage candidate pipelines, improve operational efficiency, and ensure data accuracy and compliance.
  • Schedule and coordinate all candidate interviews, ensuring a seamless experience for candidates and panelists.
  • Collaborate with the TA leadership and hiring teams to align on workforce planning and support talent development initiatives.
  • Uphold and continuously improve best practices across recruitment operations—including job postings, social campaigns, ATS workflows, and candidate communications.
  • Represent phData with professionalism, integrity, and alignment to our mission, vision, and core values.

Who You Are

  • Innovative – You’re eager to test new approaches and continuously improve.
  • Curious – You love to learn and stay ahead of recruiting trends.
  • Adaptable – You thrive in change and adjust quickly to evolving business needs.
  • Process-Driven – You identify opportunities for efficiency and implement improvements.
  • Tech-Savvy – You’re comfortable navigating recruiting systems and tools.
  • Energetic – You bring enthusiasm and urgency to a fast-paced environment.
  • Results-Oriented – You’re motivated by achieving goals and connecting world-class talent with meaningful opportunities.
  • Connected – You stay current with industry trends and maintain a strong recruiter network while engaging with talent communities.

Why phData?

  • Remote-First Work Environment
  • Casual, award-winning small-business work environment
  • Collaborative high performance culture that prizes autonomy, creativity, and transparency
  • Competitive comp, excellent benefits, generous weeks PTO plus 10 Holidays (and other cool perks)

phData celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. Todas as pessoas 50+ que desejam trabalhar na TOTVS. O seu perfil será analisado e direcionado para áreas onde estamos recrutando caso haja match.

De acordo com dados do Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estática (IBGE), as pessoas acima dos 50 anos representam mais de 25% da população e 22% da força de trabalho no Brasil. Porém, apenas 5,6% das empresas afirmaram ter contratado profissionais nessa faixa etária na mesma proporção (25%). Aqui na TOTVS temos o DNA da diversidade, a filosofia da inclusão, a busca constante por ferramentas de equidade e a valorização do pertencimento. Isso porque acreditamos que a diversidade gera criatividade e inovação, e a inovação gera a certeza de um futuro melhor, tanto pros negócios quanto para cada um de nós!

E para promover a contratação de profissionais 50+ nas diversas áreas da TOTVS, criamos um banco de talentos exclusivo para este público. title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

description:
You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel.

Talent Management Partner

The Talent Management Partner will play a critical role in driving talent strategy across the markets they support. Additionally, the Talent Management Partner will act as a key advisor on employee relations matters, ensuring compliance with policies and regulations, and fostering a fair and equitable work environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Engagement and Retention:
    • Support employee engagement programs that drive a positive workplace culture, improve morale, and reduce turnover.

    • Support our semi-annual team member engagement survey program and provide additional feedback sessions to assess employee satisfaction, partner with support team leadership to recommend, facilitate the creation of and support action plans based on the survey findings.
  • Data and Analytics:
    • Utilize data analytics to identify talent trends, gaps, and opportunities, and develop action plans to address them.
    • Leverage HR/People data and analytics to drive insights, support decision-making, and measure the effectiveness of talent programs and initiatives.
    • Prepare and present regular reports on key HR/People metrics, including turnover rates, employee engagement scores, and performance management outcomes.
  • Talent Management:
    • Implement talent management strategies, including career development programs and performance management processes for support teams.
    • Lead full cycle performance management for assigned markets.
    • Lead succession planning and high-potential identification programs to continue a strong tradition of internal leadership development and ensure a robust internal leadership pipeline.
    • Utilize expert facilitation knowledge and skills in facilitating leadership and professional development programs for frontline to senior levels across the organization.
    • Act as a coach providing coaching and mentoring to junior – senior level leaders in assigned markets.
  • Team Member Relations:
    • Collaborate with Team Member Relations Team to address employee concerns, support disciplinary actions, and ensure consistent application of policies.
    • Create and maintain a positive team member relations environment by promoting open communication, trust, and mutual respect among team members.
  • Learning and Development:
    • Deliver training and development initiatives that enhance employee skills and promote career growth.
    • Deliver training programs that support organizational effectiveness goals, such as leadership development, team-building, and communication skills.
    • Evaluate the impact of learning initiatives and adjust strategies to ensure they meet organizational needs.
  • Organizational Development:
    • Partner with operations to support the design, development, and delivery of organizational development programs that improve the team’s talent capabilities and support the achievement of business goals.
    • Support the implementation of organization design frameworks, including job architecture, reporting structures, and role clarity, to support growth and scalability.
    • Partner with leaders to analyze and redefine roles, responsibilities, and workflows to optimize team performance and productivity.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in HR/People roles with a focus on talent management, employee relations, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in implementing and supporting talent management and employee engagement programs.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to drive decisions and measure success.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of employee relations practices, employment laws, and regulations.

title: Neuroscience Sales Specialist - Melbourne, FL
description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson's disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer's disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we're here to be their difference.

Seeking talent near: Palm Bay, FL; Palm City, FL; Port Saint Lucie, FL

Position Summary

The Neuroscience Sales Specialist is responsible for achieving sales goals within the assigned territory by building strong customer relationships, delivering compliant and compelling product education, and driving appropriate patient access. This role requires expertise in neuroscience, deep knowledge of the local healthcare landscape, and the ability to partner effectively with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and key stakeholders to deliver meaningful value and service.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Promote Acadia products to HCPs in person and virtually, providing clinical, disease state, and reimbursement information in a compliant and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and execute a territory business plan to meet or exceed sales objectives, leveraging market data, customer insights, and quarterly action plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with HCPs, including key opinion leaders, advocacy organizations, and other healthcare stakeholders.
  • Address customer questions, concerns, and objections using advanced dialogue and selling skills.
  • Tailor approved sales aids, clinical reprints, and brand resources to meet specific customer needs.
  • Partner with internal colleagues (e.g., managed markets, operations, sales training, marketing) to deliver coordinated solutions.
  • Provide guidance on product pricing, reimbursement, and specialty distribution channels, acting as a liaison between customers and the Company for access-related issues.
  • Accurately track and report sales activities, business expenses, and customer interactions in a timely manner.
  • Represent Acadia at conferences, exhibits, and trainings; participate in national, regional, and local meetings as required.
  • Mentor and train new sales specialists as needed, and contribute to cross-functional projects and field strategic insights.

Knowledge & Expertise

  • Deep understanding of neuroscience disease states, Acadia products, and local/regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted resource in the medical community.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and virtual engagement platforms (e.g., Zoom, WebEx).
  • Strong grasp of payer dynamics, including Part D and specialty pharmacy/hub distribution.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; life sciences preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Sales Specialist: Minimum 1+ years of sales experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare; neuroscience preferred.
    • Senior Specialist: Minimum 5+ years of healthcare sales (2+ in complex/account-based selling).
  • Demonstrated advanced selling skills, leadership abilities, and business acumen.
  • Proven success in influencing diverse HCP audiences across multiple care settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to change, and deliver consistently high results.
  • Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and possess a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to meet travel requirements, including significant driving and overnight stays; air travel as needed.
  • Must comply with vaccination requirements for HCP office access, long-term care facilities, and medical conferences.

Scope

Applies broad experience and professional judgment to address complex business challenges, using creativity and data-driven decision-making to achieve results in a highly regulated environment.

Physical Requirements:

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication both in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedule or business needs.

Position levels:

  • Sales Specialist: $115,000.00-requires 1+ years of sales experience with at least 1 year in pharmaceutical, and/or other related healthcare sales, with an emphasis on neuroscience preferred.
  • Sales Specialist: $135,000.00- requires a minimum of 5+ years of healthcare sales with at least 2 years of experience in complex or account-based selling environments is required.

What we offer US-based Employees:

  • Competitive base, bonus, new hire and ongoing equity packages
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employer-paid life, disability, business travel and EAP coverage
  • 401(k) Plan with a fully vested company match 1:1 up to 5%
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a 2-year purchase price lock-in
  • 15+ vacation days
  • 13 -15 paid holidays, including office closure between December 24th and January 1st
  • 10 days of paid sick time
  • Paid parental leave benefit

Company Overview

Dadosfera is transforming the data landscape with a platform that delivers advanced Data, AI, and Analytics capabilities—previously available only to tech giants like Meta, Amazon, Alphabet, and Microsoft—into the hands of small and medium-sized businesses. By democratizing access to these technologies, we empower our clients to accelerate business opportunities through AI-powered Data Apps.

Our platform minimizes the time spent on cloud management and streamlines the entire data lifecycle—from collection and exploration to processing and interaction—allowing clients to focus on their business goals. Built on a high-growth SaaS model, Dadosfera offers tailored solutions that meet real business needs.

What sets Dadosfera apart is our innovative focus on speed, scalability, and flexibility, combining big data storage with advanced analytics to drive strategic decision-making. Leveraging years of experience with data platform implementations on foreign public clouds, we now deliver a cost-effective, locally adapted solution tailored for both Brazilian and global markets. By blending deep expertise with localized infrastructure, Dadosfera provides a powerful, efficient tool that optimizes corporate data management and drives data-driven transformation.

About the Job
We are looking for a Senior Data & Business Analyst (SaaS & Finance) to own and evolve our financial and operational analytics. This is a data-first role that blends the technical skills of a data analyst/engineer with the business insight of someone who understands SaaS metrics and financial performance.

You will be responsible for building automated reporting pipelines, analyzing and visualizing SaaS KPIs, and delivering actionable insights to leadership. You’ll work closely with Operations, Finance, and other teams to ensure our business data is accurate, consistent, and instantly accessible.

This role is critical to keeping our business running smoothly — especially in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment where speed, accuracy, and automation matter.

Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and automate dashboards and reports for SaaS KPIs (MRR, ARR, churn, LTV, CAC, margins, etc.).
  • Integrate and consolidate data from multiple sources (ERP, CRM, billing systems, spreadsheets) into reliable datasets.
  • Automate recurring reporting processes using SQL, APIs, and scripting languages (e.g., Python).
  • Deliver actionable insights and scenario analyses to guide strategic decisions.
  • Monitor data quality and proactively resolve inconsistencies.
  • Support Finance in forecasting, budgeting, and performance tracking — without being limited to traditional FP&A scope.
  • Collaborate with leadership to define and track metrics that matter most to the business.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a data analysis, analytics engineering, or BI role with exposure to financial and SaaS metrics.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying and transforming datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of SaaS business models and unit economics.
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills for modeling and analysis.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Intermediate or higher English fluency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in SaaS finance or FP&A teams.
  • Familiarity with ERP/accounting systems (Omie, NetSuite, QuickBooks, etc.).
  • Experience integrating APIs from CRMs, ERPs, and billing platforms.
  • Background in statistics, economics, or data science.
  • Experience working in startups or high-growth companies.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Para atuar no grupo Sapucaia do Laboratório Nacional de Luz Síncrotron (LNLS).

O Grupo SAPUCAIA é responsável pelo gerenciamento e operação da Linha de Luz SAPUCAIA da fonte de luz síncrotron Sirius, do Laboratório Nacional de Luz Síncrotron (LNLS).

A linha de luz SAPUCAIA será dedicada a estudos de morfologia e organização supramolecular de diversos tipos de materiais utilizando a técnica de espalhamento de raios X em baixos ângulos (SAXS). A aplicação desta técnica vai desde estudos biológicos, como a estrutura de proteínas e de interações de fármacos com tecidos, até aplicações em catálise e processos de formação de nanopartículas ou materiais mesoporosos. Devido ao alto fluxo da linha de luz e baixo background, estudos resolvidos no tempo em todas as áreas de pesquisas também estão previstos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar no comissionamento e operação da linha de luz Sapucaia;
  • Desenvolver e implementar instrumentação científica avançada para a linha de luz Sapucaia;
  • Desenvolver suas próprias atividades de pesquisa baseadas principalmente em SAXS de biomoléculas, independentemente ou em colaboração;
  • Comunicar-se ativamente com a comunidade científica brasileira para promover as capacidades do SAXS de biomoléculas e novas oportunidades.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Doutorado em Física, Química e/ou Biologia ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência com SAXS;
  • Experiência com instrumentação de linha de raios X;
  • Inglês fluente.

Informações adicionais

Nossos Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica – Unimed
  • Assistência Odontológica – Uniodonto
  • Assistência Psicológica – Telavita
  • Seguro de Vida – Allianz
  • Previdência Privada – BrasilPrev
  • Licença Maternidade (estendida por 6 meses)
  • Licença Paternidade (25 dias)
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Restaurante no local
  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Refeição – Pluxee (R$1.020,00/mês)
  • Fretado
  • Vale Transporte
  • Estacionamento no local
  • Clube – Telecamp
  • Clube – Associação SESC gratuita
  • Wellhub – desconto em academias
  • Convênios com empresas que oferecem descontos

Reafirmamos nosso compromisso com a diversidade, equidade e inclusão, incentivando a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência, neurodivergentes, mulheres, LGBTI+, de diversas etnias, gerações e corpos, além de outros grupos socialmente marginalizados.

Faça parte do CNPEM! No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.

Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).

Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades.

A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.

Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal.

Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas.

Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

About Swissker (formerly Swissklip)

Swissklip USA Inc. is a fast-growing, data-driven DTC brand delivering personal care solutions designed specifically for the 50+ demographic in the U.S. Our best-selling products include heavy-duty nail clippers, anti-fungal treatments, and specialty hygiene essentials that solve real everyday problems.

Email/SMS is a key strategic growth channel for us in 2025–26. We're focused on driving lifecycle marketing, improving conversion rates, and scaling revenue while maintaining top-tier brand communications for a cohesive customer experience.

Job Summary

We're seeking a professional with 5–8 years of hands-on email marketing experience who excels in both strategy and execution. You'll own the end-to-end email channel — from lifecycle flows and campaign calendars to segmentation, deliverability, testing, and analytics. Working cross-functionally with content, design, product, and growth teams, you'll drive retention, engagement, and revenue through email.

Core Responsibilities

  • Develop comprehensive email marketing strategies aligned with broader growth and retention goals
  • Define customer lifecycle stages and map email flows (welcome, onboarding, re-engagement, abandoned cart, upsell, win-back, etc.)
  • Segment audiences, define targeting rules, and tailor messaging for each cohort
  • Create a balanced campaign calendar (weekly/monthly) for promotional, content, and behavioral sends
  • Establish email KPIs and goals (open rate, CTR, conversion, deliverability, list growth, engagement, etc.)
  • Develop strategy for multi-brand setup (current brands and future brand development)

Execution & Operations

  • Build, test, and send email campaigns using Klaviyo
  • Design responsive email templates tested across various devices and environments
  • Set up and maintain automation flows, triggers, and behavioral journeys
  • Conduct A/B and multivariate testing of subject lines, copy, creative elements, send times, etc.
  • Monitor deliverability, sender reputation, spam complaints, inbox placement, and bounces
  • Maintain list hygiene through segmentation, suppression lists, re-engagement, and opt-out management
  • Coordinate with design, content, and growth teams for assets, copy, and promotion strategy
  • Track campaign performance, identify insights, and implement optimizations
  • Forecast, budget, and track ROI of email initiatives

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Work with product, growth, customer success, and engineering teams on integrations, data feeds, and personalization
  • Stay current on email trends, deliverability best practices, and compliance laws (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CASL, etc.)
  • Recommend and test new tools, plugins, and optimizations to enhance the email channel

Qualifications

Must-Haves

  • 5-8+ years of direct, hands-on email marketing experience
  • Proven success managing lifecycle flows, segmentation, and campaign execution
  • Strong understanding of deliverability, sender infrastructure, and inbox placement
  • Experience with email service providers and automation platforms
  • Solid analytical skills with proficiency in metrics, dashboards, and data queries (SQL)
  • Experience with A/B testing and data-driven optimization
  • Strong copywriting skills, attention to detail, and design sensibility
  • Experience working in fast-paced startup or growth environments
  • Familiarity with email compliance laws (GDPR, CAN-SPAM, CASL, etc.)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams

Nice-to-Haves/Bonus

  • Experience integrating email with SMS, push, or other owned channels
  • Experience in e-commerce, specifically personal care products
  • Familiarity with the supplement industry
  • Knowledge of subscription infrastructure and lifecycle marketing integration
  • Experience with personalization, dynamic content, predictive modeling, or AI-based optimization
  • Basic HTML/CSS skills for email templates

What Success Looks Like

  • Contribution and Improved LTV Through Lifecycle Marketing: Email/SMS campaigns and flows run consistently, on time, and drive measurable improvements in open rates, click-through rates, and conversions.
  • Lifecycle Excellence: Automated lifecycle programs (welcome, onboarding, abandoned cart, re-engagement, win-back) are fully built out, optimized, and deliver incremental revenue.
  • Segmentation & Personalization: Our list is well-segmented with personalized messaging that creates clear engagement lifts across customer cohorts.
  • Deliverability Health: List hygiene, deliverability, and sender reputation remain strong through active management, ensuring emails reliably reach inboxes.
  • Data-Driven Decisions: Campaigns are backed by testing and insights, with clear reporting that connects email performance to revenue, retention, and customer growth.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Email seamlessly integrates with product launches, promotions, and growth initiatives through strong collaboration across design, product, and growth teams.
  • Ownership Mindset: You become the recognized subject matter expert for all things email at Swissklip, making the channel a reliable driver of both short-term results and long-term customer loyalty.

title: Staff SEIT Lead - Remote Sensing Programs
description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available
CLEARANCE TYPE: SCI TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Overview

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people\'s lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation\'s history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they\'re making history.

The Payload and Ground Systems Division within Northrop Grumman Space Systems is a strategic partner specializing in delivering intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance solutions for classified and unclassified missions in space. Headquartered in Linthicum, Maryland, PGS RSP has offices, manufacturing, and world-class assembly, integration, and test facilities. We do it all here, on-site, from sensors to payloads to full up spacecraft, supporting Class A to Class D missions. Our key capabilities include Active RF, Passive RF, and Electro-Optical payloads, space solar power, cross domain missions, and space resilience payloads & solutions.

This position is for a Staff Systems Engineer to join our Remote Sensing Programs Systems Engineering, Integration and Test (RSP SEIT) team as a SEIT Lead . As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to support efforts on both concept and product development to deliver key solutions to our customers. We cover a wide variety of expertise within the systems engineering domain. This includes mission engineering, requirements, architecture, modeling and simulation, integration and test, verification, and validation, and many more!

The SEIT Lead is responsible for directing the execution of the overall systems engineering, integration, and test (SEIT) effort on the program and is responsible for horizontal and vertical integration across all engineering elements of the program. The ideal candidate ensures the integrity of engineering processes and timely development of core engineering work products. The SEIT Lead typically has Control Account Manager (CAM) responsibility, which comprises cost and schedule management for the SEIT work scope. And interfaces with the Program Manager, Chief Engineer, System Architect, other engineering team leads, as well as the customer.

The position will be responsible for leading systems engineering tasks for space subsystems, payloads and/or vehicles. These may include, but are not limited to:

  • Serve as the cost account manager for the systems engineering (and potentially multiple other organizations) responsibilities.
  • Plan and execute the core functions and ensure the project team has qualified staff to execute the program core functions.
  • Lead technical management and execution of the SE team.
  • Plan, execute, and close out program reviews and milestones (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, etc.)
  • Ensure system technical compliance with the program Statement of Work (SOW), system requirements, and manage scope control of technical team.
  • Manage the vertical and horizontal technical integration throughout the product teams and program life cycle.
  • Oversee configuration management of the overall Program Baseline
  • Serve as the technical interface with the customer.
  • Collect, manage, and report the program metrics and Technical Performance Measures (TPMs).
  • Manage risk and opportunity and the production of core engineering work products and track the work products and associated program dependencies in the program schedule.
  • Oversee the establishment and execution of the program lifecycle and work products.
  • Coordinate between the technical leads, program manager, and customer to ensure the integrity and executability of the program technical baseline.
  • Act as primary technical working group lead and interface with external parties; managing contractor giver-receivers, track actions, and manage technical team interactions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Must have an active U.S. Government DoD Top Secret security clearance at time of application, current and within scope, with the ability to obtain and maintain SCI approval/access.
  • Bachelor’s degree with 12 years of experience, a Master\'s degree with 10 years of experience or a PhD with 7 years of experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Physics, Applied Mathematics, or related technical fields.
  • Experience leading technical teams.
  • Experience in systems development, integration, and test.
  • Demonstrated Multi-Disciplinary Engineering exposure (Software, Hardware, Electrical) and strong ability to communicate cross-functionally.
  • Demonstrated strong communication skills.
  • Ability to work 100% on-site full-time in Linthicum, MD

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master\'s degree or Ph.D. in STEM or technical management.
  • Risk and Opportunity Management experience.
  • Experience with Earned Value Management (EVMS)
  • Experience with Space sensor payloads, including antennas, radar, EO/IR, and/or communications.
  • Experience interfacing with large multi-site/multi-division teams.
  • Update as appropriate for band level of requisition

Primary Level Salary Range: $157,500.00 - $236,300.00

Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Leveraging years of experience with data platform implementations on foreign public clouds, we now deliver a cost-effective, locally adapted solution tailored for both Brazilian and global markets. By blending deep expertise with localized infrastructure, Dadosfera provides a powerful, efficient tool that optimizes corporate data management and drives data-driven transformation.

About the Job


We’re looking for a highly skilled Full-Stack Engineer with strong UX/UI design capabilities to lead the complete redesign and rebuild of our company website. This role blends visual design, front-end engineering, and light back-end work — and demands a strong sense of ownership, autonomy, and cross-functional collaboration.

You’ll be responsible for designing a completely new web experience from scratch (in Figma or similar), implementing it in production-ready code, and ensuring that all app and product functionality currently tied to the website continues to work seamlessly after the redesign. The website is a core part of our commercial strategy and online sales funnel — your work will directly impact the future of the company.

You’ll work closely with the CEO, CTO, COO and Marketing to translate vision into execution. You’ll also help define foundational UX and design systems for future iterations.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the complete redesign and implementation of our website.
  • Create wireframes and high-fidelity designs using tools like Figma.
  • Translate designs into scalable, responsive code using React, Next.js, and TailwindCSS (or equivalent); Angular is a bonus.
  • Refactor the existing codebase while preserving complex app/product interdependencies.
  • Optimize the site for performance, responsiveness, and accessibility.
  • Collaborate with leadership to ensure the site aligns with commercial goals (especially online sales flows and billing system integration).
  • Propose and implement architectural improvements where needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in full-stack development with a strong front-end focus.

description:
Job description

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Main responsibilities

  • Atuar na comercialização internacional de carne bovina, gerindo negociações com clientes em mercados estratégicos.
  • Monitorar diariamente os mercados globais, câmbio, fretes e tendências de consumo, propondo estratégias comerciais alinhadas ao posicionamento da Minerva.
  • Definir preços de venda, volumes e prazos, buscando maximizar margens e competitividade.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo e estratégico com clientes, parceiros comerciais e stakeholders internos.
  • Coordenar fluxo entre áreas internas (logística, financeiro, operações, qualidade e documentação) garantindo execução eficiente dos contratos.
  • Realizar análises de risco e oportunidades de mercado, utilizando ferramentas de hedge, contratos futuros e opções quando aplicável.
  • Apoiar o time na elaboração de relatórios de mercado, previsões de demanda e inteligência comercial para suportar decisões estratégicas.

Requirements and skills

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Comércio Exterior, Agronegócios ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Comércio Internacional, Gestão de Riscos ou Agronegócio será considerado diferencial.

Experiência Profissional:

  • Experiência consolidada em trading de proteínas animais , com ênfase em carne bovina (obrigatório).
  • Vivência em negociação internacional de outras commodities agropecuárias (soja, milho, farelos, DDGS ou grãos em geral).
  • Experiência prévia em frigoríficos ou empresas do setor de proteína animal, com entendimento de processos produtivos, rendimento industrial e especificações de cortes para exportação.
  • Histórico de gestão de contratos de exportação, definição de preços e acompanhamento de execução logística internacional.

Conhecimentos Técnicos e Ferramentas:

  • Forte domínio de precificação de cortes bovinos e subprodutos , considerando custos, margens e particularidades de cada mercado.
  • Conhecimento de formação de preços em grãos e insumos relacionados à cadeia de proteína animal.
  • Capacidade de análise de mercado (oferta, demanda, câmbio, fretes, relatórios setoriais – USDA, Urner Barry, Gira etc.).
  • Familiaridade com derivativos agrícolas (futuros e opções) como ferramenta de gestão de risco – desejável, mas não essencial.
  • Experiência em logística internacional de carnes e grãos , incluindo incoterms, custos de frete e barreiras regulatórias (MAPA, USDA, AQSIQ, SFDA, entre outros).
  • Excel avançado e ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Experiência com ERP (SAP será diferencial).

Idiomas:

  • Inglês avançado/fluente (essencial para negociação internacional).
  • Espanhol altamente desejável; Mandarim é diferencial competitivo.

Habilidades Interpessoais e Comportamentais:

  • Forte capacidade de negociação global e relacionamento de longo prazo com clientes e fornecedores.
  • Perfil analítico, com leitura de mercado e habilidade em tomada de decisão sob cenários voláteis.
  • Proatividade, resiliência e visão estratégica voltada para resultados.
  • Habilidade de atuar em ambientes multiculturais e de alta pressão.

Certificações e Cursos Desejáveis:

  • Certificações em Comércio Exterior (ComexGestão, ICC, FIATA).

Responsible for departmental operations planning/execution or is focused on execution of professional activities within a technical discipline. Functions with some autonomy but guided by established policies or review of end results.

The job allows modification of procedures and practices covering work as long as the end results meet standards of acceptability (quality, volume, timeliness etc.).

  • Work closely with the Quality Assurance team and act as lean leader in the Shop. Take ownership on Kaizen/Lean events with the ultimate goal of defining processes improvements and cost reduction initiatives. Create new Procedures and Processes and/or update existing ones as needed.
  • Manage inventory levels and guarantee accuracy through cycle and annual counting. Expected to manage the inventory based on standard KPI's. Define, implement and control best practices to mitigate Excess & Obsolescence. Work with suppliers and Tax Team to promptly treat Scrap components.
  • Implement S&OP based on backlog and forecast with support from Planning Team. Have full control and visibility of Manufacturing Workload and manage resources as required to fulfill Business' requests. Report Manufacturing Workload through regular updates.
  • Manage shop operational activities such as equipment assembly inside our shop and outsourced, internal test activities and factory acceptance tests with customers. Guarantee exceptional customer experience and high quality standards of our products. Promote daily, weekly and monthly meetings with internal Supply Chain Team to update project schedules and actions.
  • Develop, control and update projects' internal schedules. Responsible for On Time Delivery and Quality assurance.
  • Work in partnership with project management and engineering. Suggest mechanical layout, wiring diagram and overall project improvements as part of the continuous improvement cycle.
  • Develop, implement and control all Manufacturing KPIs.
  • Responsible for all Facilities activities such as industrial and building maintenance, janitorial and P&E (Plant & Equipment) projects. Responsible for negotiating with suppliers (with Support from Sourcing). Responsible for strongly acting with Suppliers for all Facilities & Building maintenance, renovation and/or expansion. Control CAPEX budget and schedule.
  • Expected to demonstrate high levels of safety, security and quality practices and act as the role model in such values for the overall plant staff.

  • Graduation in an accredited university in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering.
  • Advanced English skills
  • Previous experience of at least 3-5 years in the Energy or Oil & Gas industry acting in a global company with projects of high and moderate complexity.

  • Ability to influence people and lead medium teams.

  • Responsible for the Shop QC (Quality Control) and guarantee material compliance according to engineering standards and customer requirements. Act as the point of contact in Supply Chain for TRS (Technical Regulations and Standards) matters of discussion with Engineering and ITO.
  • Coordinate the national logistics chain (inbound & outbound) as well as the factory material flow. Overall shipping documents, packaging and wooden crates processes are also part of the scope.
  • Previous experience working with highly customized projects for customers in Latin America
  • Intermediate Spanish skills

description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel, and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

Innodata is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

O MAIOR HUB DE EDUCAÇÃO E TECNOLOGIAS PARA A PRÁTICA MÉDICA DO BRASIL.

A marca Afya nasceu em 2019, mas nossa história começou muito antes. Surgimos da união entre a NRE Educacional, maior grupo de faculdades de Medicina do país, fundado em 1999, com a MEDCEL, marca de cursos preparatórios para prova de residência médica.

Com o nosso crescimento acelerado, adquirimos nos últimos anos novas unidades de ensino — já são mais de 30 espalhadas pelo Brasil — e mais de 10 startups que oferecem soluções digitais para a prática médica — Afya Whitebook, Afya iClinic, Afya Papers, Glic e Cliquefarma são algumas marcas do nosso portfólio. Acesse afya.com.br para conhecer mais sobre a nossa história e todas as soluções que oferecemos.

A Afya é uma companhia de capital aberto desde 2019, com ações negociadas na bolsa de valores Nasdaq, nos Estados Unidos. Em 2023 disponibilizamos nossas ações também na bolsa brasileira, a B3. Saiba mais sobre esse assunto em ir.afya.com.br .

Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação. Para isso, contamos com um time de 10 mil pessoas curiosas, parceiras, comprometidas, adaptáveis e realizadoras. Gente de todos os cantos do Brasil, com diferentes sotaques, mas falando a mesma língua, unida pelo mesmo propósito.   • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

Nossa trajetória de pioneirismo ao longo dos últimos anos nos proporcionou um amplo know-how e expertise em todas as nuances do setor logístico. Essa jornada nos permitiu acumular valiosa experiência e nos destacar como líderes em oferecer as melhores práticas do mercado.

Além de nosso conhecimento aprofundado, a segurança é uma prioridade essencial para nós. Somos certificados pela ISO/IEC 27001, garantindo que adotemos os mais rigorosos padrões em segurança da informação, demonstrando nosso compromisso com a proteção de nossos parceiros e clientes.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Analista de Qualidade. Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Main responsibilities

Ah, uma informação importante sobre essa vaga: o modelo de trabalho proposto é remoto .

Main responsibilities

Agora dá uma olhada nas principais responsabilidades da vaga:

  • Desdobrar OKRs em planos táticos trimestrais e roadmaps integrados; gerenciar calendário de releases; facilitar priorização e gerir dependências entre squads; e conduzir ritos táticos (planning, review, retro, check semanal), garantindo DoR/DoD claros.
  • Padronizar e evoluir o fluxo atrelado às esteiras de desenvolvimento de produto; reduzir retrabalho e lead time; garantir qualidade de releases (gate de release, go/no-go, checklist) e integração com CI/CD e performance; estruturar e acompanhar planos de hardening e redução de débito técnico.
  • Facilitar e apoiar planejamento para automação de testes, cobertura e ambientes de QA; definir SLIs/SLOs com SRE; operar o ciclo de incidentes com CloudOps, SecOps (detecção, resposta, post-mortem e ações corretivas) e TIC; melhorar MTTR/MTBF; incorporar práticas DevSecOps e conformidade (LGPD/ISO/NIST/CIS) no SDLC.
  • Monitorar custo de infra vs. adoção/usuários ativos; promover otimizações e planejamento de capacidade; acompanhar orçamento tático de tecnologia e variações relevantes; apoiar compras/renovações.
  • Manter dashboard tático com throughput, lead/cycle time, bugs por release, disponibilidade, custos, risco e progresso de OKRs; conduzir análises de causa-raiz e planos de melhoria contínua; reportar status e riscos ao CTO.
  • Fazer 1:1s com coordenações/tech leads; dar feedbacks, apoiar trilhas de carreira e sucessão; apoiar atração, seleção e onboarding; fomentar cultura de colaboração, segurança e aprendizagem.
  • Gerenciar RACI, playbooks (SDLC, change management, incidentes), catálogo de serviços e SLAs/SLIs/SLOs; zelar pela documentação viva e pela aderência aos processos acordados.
  • Alinhar prioridades com Produto, CX, Jurídico e áreas de negócio; gerir expectativas com comunicação clara e sem surpresas; conduzir comitês/cerimônias de decisão quando necessário.

Requirements and skills

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

Formação

Sempre que possível, Graduação completa em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência/Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência

  • 7+ anos no ecossistema de desenvolvimento/operações de software;
  • 3+ anos em gestão direta de times e líderes técnicos (coordenações/tech leads);
  • Atuação prévia liderando equipes em negócios de modelo SaaS; e
  • Atuação com equipes multidisciplinares (produto, CX, jurídico, segurança) e gestão de mudanças organizacionais.

Conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

  • SDLC ponta a ponta e rituais ágeis (planning, review, retro) com DoR/DoD claros.
  • CI/CD com gates de qualidade, versionamento, gestão de mudanças e calendário de releases.
  • Cloud (preferencialmente GCP) e práticas de SRE/observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces; SLIs/SLOs).

  • Capacidade de construir e operar dashboards táticos (engenharia, qualidade, confiabilidade e FinOps básico: custo vs. uso/usuário).

Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação executiva e clareza na gestão de stakeholders.
  • Priorização orientada a valor, pensamento sistêmico e tomada de decisão data-driven.
  • Gestão de conflitos, facilitação de ritos e senso de urgência em incidentes.
  • Liderança de líderes (feedbacks, 1:1s, desenvolvimento de carreira).

Ferramentas e idiomas

  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão do trabalho (ex.: Jira), documentação viva e observabilidade/APM.
  • Inglês técnico e avançado (leitura/escrita e conversação em contexto profissional).

É um diferencial se você tiver:

Experiência setorial

Job Overview

We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding.
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction.

  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude.
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively.
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, data enrichment tools, automated workflows) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance.

$1,500 Sign-On Bonus. Our job opportunities allow you to leverage your expertise and compassion to make a direct impact on the health and well-being of others. Join our team and be rewarded with competitive compensation and flexible scheduling while making a difference in the community!

  • Full-time (FT) Opportunities - Our PRN providers can transition to FT roles supporting their home location, or a state or region - and receive a FT sign on bonus.

Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree or commensurate experience and satisfactory completion of NP licensure
  • Current NP licensure in state of practice to include prescription authority or the ability to obtain prescriptive authority as needed
  • AANP, AACN, or ANCC board certification in Adult, Adult Gerontology Primary Care, Adult Gerontology Acute Care, Family, Emergency, or Acute Care specialty
  • Current BLS, ACLS or CPR certification
  • 1 year of NP experience preferred, new grads encouraged to apply!
  • Valid state driver's license and proof of adequate automobile insurance coverage for the state of residence
  • Strong computer skills and familiarity with employee health/medical record software
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
